pages.commitMessage:
docs(wiki): ingest the 2026-09-01 findings into the entity and concept pages

Snapshot: raw/strategy/2026-09-01-portfolio-inversion-aio-tracker-dataset.md

New:
- wiki/pages/concepts/aio-citation-tracking.md — the instrument, its limits, and
  the explicit warning not to quote it until two runs agree
- wiki/pages/site-pages/chair-specs-dataset.md — including "do not score this as
  a money page, a citation target that sells things is one nobody cites"

Updated:
- affiliate-performance.md — two of three tags have never recorded a click, and
  the cause was the link inventory rather than the copy
- ctr-optimization.md — the 80% AIO figure has never been observed; flagged at
  the top of the page rather than left as a quoted number
- godseye-nightly.md — escalated was pointed at the instrumentation for three
  weeks, plus the new seam rule
- index.md, log.md, decisions-log.md

New seam rule recorded: a detector that can tell it is blind must say so in the
field the verdict is read from. A correct diagnosis written where nothing reads
it is the same as no diagnosis.
